description: Check the status and retrieve results of any Precept enrichment or search job. All Precept tools (search leads, enrich leads, company insights, search companies) are asynchronous and return an enrichment_id (jobId). Returns status 'pending', 'processing' or 'in_progress' with progress info while running, 'completed' with the full results, or 'failed' with error details. Jobs can take up to about 10 minutes. Checking every ~4 seconds for up to about 150 checks gives the best experience, with a brief progress update to the user every minute or so. If a job is still running after that, it's usually still working: share the jobId so the user can check back later.

jobId.description: The enrichment_id returned by any of the Precept search or enrichment tools.

name: precept_get_job_status

outputSchema.description: Job status and full data results when completed

credits.description: Total credits billed for this job

name.description: Readable name of the job if specified

progress.description: Progress counters while the job is still running

completed.description: Number of items processed so far

results.description: Array of discovered lead or company objects when completed

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the job (e.g. 'pending', 'in_progress', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')

title: Get Job Status
